title: We confess real purification into piety, justice, and holy works
source_text: XXV. Sed ista falso atque injuria nobis tribui patet ex iis quae diximus, siquidem ultro confitemur Deum illos quos justificat, atque in gratiam recipit, a peccatis purgare, & ex peccatoribus, immundis & impiis, pios, justos & sanctos reddere; & ita per Spiritum in illis operari, ut abnegata omni impietate, & mundanis cupiditatibus, bonis operibus studeant, & proferant fructus poenitentia dignos.
pass_a_gloss: But that these things are falsely and injuriously attributed to us is clear from what we have said, since we freely confess that God purges those whom he justifies and receives into grace from sins, and from sinners, unclean and impious, renders them pious, just, and holy; and so works by the Spirit in them that, having denied all ungodliness and worldly desires, they study good works and bring forth fruits worthy of repentance.
pass_b_english: We freely confess God truly purges the justified from sin into piety, justice, and holiness.
The Spirit makes them deny ungodliness and bear repentance-worthy works.
